17-13-0303-C(1) TYPE 1 NARRATIVE
4901 WEST FERDINAND STREET, CHICAGO, ILLINOIS 60644

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: Approximately 12,026 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a Type 1 map amendment from the existing RS-3 Residential
Single-Unit (Detached House) District to the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and
Multi-Unit District to allow the construction of a new two-story masonry veneer
church/religious assembly building at 4901 West Ferdinand Street. The proposed
building contains approximately 6,775 square feet of floor areaand will be approximately
30 feet-9 inches in height. The development will provide twenty-one (21) off-street
automobile parking spaces and six (6) bicycle parking spaces. The proposed east side
setback is 5.00 feet, the proposed west side setback is 6.83 feet, and the proposed rear
setback is 28.21 feet. The proposed rear-yard open space is zero (0) square feet The
Applicant seeks all zoning relief necessary and permitted through the elective Type 1
process pursuant to Sections 17-13-0303 and 17-13-1100 of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, as reflected in the application and plans submitted herewith.

(A) | The Project's Floor Area Ratio: Approximately 6,775 square feet (0.56 FAR)
(B) The Project's Density (Minimum Lot Area Not applicable - no dwelling units are proposed.
per D.U.):
(C) The amount of off-street parking: Twenty-one (21) automobile parking spaces; six (6) bicycle

parking spaces.

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: See Type | plans
b. Combined Side Setbacks: 11.83 feet total (5.00 feet east / 6.83 feet west)
c. Rear Setback: 28.21 feet
The Applicant seeks variation relief to reduce the minimum required rear setback from
36.00 feet to 28.21 feet; the east side setback from 13.06 feet to 5.00 feet; the west side
setback from 13.06 feet to 6.83 feet; and the minimum required rear-yard open space

from 782 square feet to zero (0) square feet, in accordance with the Type 1 plans
submitted herewith.

(E) Building Height: Approximately 30 feet-9 inches

The proposed development will be constructed in substantial accordance with the Type | site plan, floor plans, elevations, landscape
plan, and other plans submitted with the zoning amendment application.
